title: CLI baseline guard: refuse writes under .cloverleaf/baselines/ when baselines_pending is true (bug #5)
definition_of_done: cloverleaf-cli (via a guard in reference-impl/lib/cli.ts or reference-impl/lib/ui-review-state.ts) exits non-zero with a descriptive error message when asked to write a file under .cloverleaf/baselines/ and the task's .cloverleaf/runs/<taskId>/ui-review/state.json has baselines_pending: true
The guard is enforced at the CLI layer independently of prompt text, so no prompt change is required to activate it
Changes pass the existing reference-impl test suite; a new unit test covers the guard rejection path
acceptance_criteria: cloverleaf-cli write-ui-review-state (or the relevant baseline-write command) exits with a non-zero code and a descriptive error when baselines_pending is true in the task's ui-review state (RFC AC #9)
The guard cannot be bypassed by omitting a prompt instruction; it is enforced in TypeScript CLI code
A unit test in reference-impl/tests/ fails against v0.6.0 behavior (no guard) and passes against v0.6.1 behavior (guard present) (RFC AC #1)
Retroactive baseline writes for already-merged tasks (e.g., CLV-27) are not affected; the guard applies only to the active task's state file
